NDT training in Austin: how it works for Austin employers and technicians

Short answer: Atlantis NDT delivers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training for Austin and Central Texas at Level I, II and III in UT, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT, PT, VT and ET. The classroom portion is live online and practical training is delivered onsite at your facility, whether a fab-construction site, a fabrication shop or a power plant, under ASNT Level III oversight. Your employer certifies you under its written practice. Texas radiographers also need separate state certification. Quotes on request.

Austin's NDT market looks very different from Houston's. There is no refinery row here. Instead, Central Texas has become one of the most intense industrial construction zones in North America: semiconductor fabs in Austin and Taylor, an electric-vehicle gigafactory east of the city, a wave of data centres, new highway and interchange projects, and the power plants and pipelines that feed all of it. That work needs technicians who can inspect structural welds, process and utility piping, pressure equipment and rotating plant, often to tight construction schedules.

Atlantis NDT does not have a training centre in Austin. We teach theory live online and bring practical training to your site or shop anywhere in Central Texas. Request an Austin training quote and we will reply with cohort and onsite options within one business day.

ASNT Level I, II and III courses available in Austin

All courses follow ASNT SNT-TC-1A and are offered at Level I, Level II and as Level III examination preparation. The third column is market context for Central Texas; your employer's written practice and client specifications decide what is required.

MethodLevelsWhat Austin employers use it forPrerequisite
UT (Ultrasonic Testing)I, II, III prepStructural weld inspection on fab, data-centre and highway steel; thickness surveys on plant piping and vesselsLevel I: employer entry rules; Level II: Level I plus experience per written practice
PAUT (Phased Array UT)II, III prepPiping and pressure-equipment welds on industrial construction, where RT exclusion zones would halt other tradesUT Level II (or concurrent) recommended
TOFD (Time of Flight Diffraction)II, III prepThick-section weld sizing on vessels, boilers and power-plant componentsUT Level II recommended
RT (Radiographic Testing)I, II, III prepPipeline and process-piping weld radiography, fabrication-shop RT, casting inspectionTexas radiographer certification required separately for source use
MT (Magnetic Particle Testing)I, II, III prepStructural steel connections, crane and equipment components, carbon-steel fabrication weldsEmployer entry rules
PT (Liquid Penetrant Testing)I, II, III prepStainless and high-purity process piping, non-ferrous parts, machined componentsEmployer entry rules
VT (Visual Testing)I, II, III prepStructural welding inspection, orbital-weld and piping visual checks, bridge and plant condition surveysEmployer entry rules
ET (Eddy Current Testing)I, II, III prepHeat-exchanger and condenser tubing in power plants, aircraft and rotorcraft components, coating thicknessEmployer entry rules

UT content. Wave physics, transducers and wedges, calibration and reference standards, thickness gauging, angle-beam weld inspection, DAC and TCG, flaw sizing and reporting. We emphasise structural weld inspection and the AWS D1.1 approach to UT because it is so common on Central Texas construction projects.

PAUT and TOFD content. Focal laws, sectorial and linear scans, encoded scanning, scan plans and coverage, TOFD set-up and interpretation, and data review. On crowded construction sites, owners often prefer ultrasonic methods to radiography because they avoid shutting down areas for radiation safety.

RT content. Sources, exposure geometry, film and digital imaging, IQIs and interpretation. The method course does not replace the Texas radiographer certification described below.

MT, PT, VT and ET content. Method physics, equipment, technique selection, code acceptance criteria and documentation. Level III candidates get structured preparation for the Basic, Method and Specific exams; see ASNT Level III training.

SNT-TC-1A certification path in Austin, step by step

Texas does not license NDT technicians as such, except for radiography, which has its own state certification. For every method, SNT-TC-1A certification is issued by your employer:

  1. Employer written practice sets training, experience, exams and pass marks per method and level.
  2. Classroom training in the method, delivered by Atlantis NDT live online or onsite. For recommended minimums, see our training-requirements matrix.
  3. On-the-job experience, documented and supervised. On construction projects, log the project and code for each entry.
  4. General examination on method theory.
  5. Specific examination on your employer's equipment, procedures and acceptance criteria.
  6. Practical examination on real specimens, administered under a Level III.
  7. Vision examination, near-vision and colour contrast, typically annual.
  8. Employer certification, approved by the responsible Level III.
  9. Recertification at the interval in the written practice. For RT, keep your Texas radiographer certification current as well.

Our SNT-TC-1A certification guide explains each step in detail.

Online, live-virtual or onsite NDT training for Austin crews

  • Live online. Instructor-led in real time, so technicians working long construction shifts in Taylor, Round Rock or Del Valle do not lose days commuting. See NDT training online.
  • Onsite at your facility. Practical training at your shop, laydown yard or plant with your equipment and procedures, under Level III oversight. Ask about onsite training for your Austin crew.
  • Dedicated cohorts when several candidates are ready at once, which is common for contractors ramping up for a new project.

Scheduling around construction peaks and outages. Large industrial builds have steel-erection and piping peaks when every inspector is on the job, and Central Texas power plants schedule maintenance outages in the milder spring and fall months, avoiding summer peak demand. We schedule online theory ahead of those peaks so your people arrive qualified, and plan practicals in the gaps. Tell us your project schedule and we will build around it.

The practical exam is always on real specimens under a Level III, never online.

Where NDT technicians work in Austin

  • Semiconductor fabs. Samsung has long operated a fab in Austin and has built a major new fab in Taylor, and other chipmakers and equipment suppliers operate in the region. Fab construction involves large volumes of structural steel, process and utility piping, and high-purity systems where VT, PT and weld inspection are routine.
  • EV and advanced manufacturing. Tesla's Gigafactory Texas east of Austin and its supplier base, plus a growing number of battery, equipment and industrial manufacturers, need structural, piping and equipment inspection during construction and maintenance.
  • Data centres. Central Texas has become an active data-centre market, with steel-framed buildings, generator plants and cooling systems that call for structural weld inspection under AWS D1.1 and piping inspection.
  • Power generation. The LCRA Fayette Power Project near La Grange and Austin Energy's gas-fired plants are among the regional generators, and the ERCOT grid has seen new gas, battery and renewable construction across Central Texas. Plants need UT, ET on condenser and heat-exchanger tubing, MT and PT during outages.
  • Pipelines. Major crude, natural-gas and NGL pipelines carrying Permian production toward the Gulf Coast cross Central Texas. Construction and repair welding is typically inspected to API 1104, and integrity programmes follow federal PHMSA rules and Texas Railroad Commission oversight of intrastate lines.
  • Transport infrastructure. TxDOT is headquartered in Austin, and projects such as the I-35 reconstruction through the city involve steel bridge and structural work that references AWS D1.5 for bridge welding.
  • Aviation and defence. Austin-Bergstrom International Airport and the Army aviation presence at Fort Cavazos, north of the metro, support aviation maintenance where ET, UT and PT are the core methods.
  • Fabrication shops. Central Texas shops fabricate skids, tanks, vessels, structural steel and piping spools for the projects above, working to ASME Section VIII, B31.3 and Section V.

Radiography licensing in Texas. Texas is an NRC Agreement State, and industrial radiography is regulated by the Texas Department of State Health Services (DSHS) Radiation Control programme, which is based in Austin. Companies performing radiography need a Texas licence or registration, and individuals must hold Texas industrial radiographer certification. Texas recognises three levels: radiographer trainee, radiographer and radiographer trainer, with trainees working under the personal supervision of a radiographer trainer. The rules are in 25 TAC §289.255. This state certification is separate from, and additional to, your SNT-TC-1A RT certification. Our RT course teaches technique and interpretation; it does not issue Texas radiographer certification. Check current requirements with DSHS and your radiation safety officer.

What Austin employers typically ask for. Construction inspection firms ask for SNT-TC-1A Level II in UT, MT and VT, often alongside AWS CWI. Piping and plant contractors add PAUT, PT and RT, and some owner inspector roles ask for API 510 or 570. Atlantis does not provide CWI or API programmes. For earnings context, see our NDT salary guide.

Level III services and written practices for Austin NDT companies

Central Texas has many new and fast-growing inspection companies formed to serve the construction boom. Many of them need a written practice, procedures and a Level III before they can bid owner work. We provide:

  • Written practice development for your methods and client requirements. See NDT written practice development.
  • Procedures for UT (including AWS D1.1 structural UT), PAUT, TOFD, MT, PT, VT, ET and RT technique.
  • Level III examinations and audit-ready certification records.
  • Corporate programmes to bring a whole new crew up to Level II. See corporate NDT training.

Book a Level III consultation, or read our SNT-TC-1A guidance first.

Practise before the practical exam

The Practical NDT 3D simulator lets trainees practise 12 methods in 5 environments: NDT lab, welding workshop, aircraft hangar, oil and gas site and storage tank. Structural and fabrication inspectors will get most from the welding workshop; pipeline and plant crews from the oil and gas and tank scenes.

It is practice only. It does not replace hands-on training with real equipment, and it does not replace the practical examination on real specimens under a Level III.

Your instructor

Courses are led by Anoop Rayavarapu, ASNT NDT Level III and founder of Atlantis NDT, who designs the curriculum and oversees onsite programmes and examinations.

Frequently asked questions about NDT training in Austin

How do I get NDT certified in Austin?

Work for or be sponsored by an employer that certifies under SNT-TC-1A, complete the training and experience in its written practice, pass general, specific and practical exams under a Level III and a vision test, and the employer certifies you. For radiography, you also need Texas radiographer certification.

Can I take NDT training online in Texas?

Yes, the classroom portion is delivered live online. Practical training and the practical exam are completed hands-on at your employer's facility or an arranged location. See online NDT training.

Is there an NDT school in Austin?

Atlantis NDT does not run a physical school in Austin. We train online and onsite at employers' facilities across Central Texas.

How long does UT Level 2 training take?

It depends on your employer's written practice, your starting level and your work schedule. See SNT-TC-1A recommended minimums in our training-requirements matrix.

Do I need a license for radiography in Texas?

Yes. Texas requires industrial radiographer certification from DSHS in addition to employer-based SNT-TC-1A certification, and the employer must hold a Texas licence or registration. Trainees work under the personal supervision of a certified radiographer trainer.

What does NDT training cost in Austin?

We do not publish prices. It depends on method, level, group size and delivery mode. Request a quote; cohort and onsite quotes within one business day.

Is ASNT certification recognised by Austin employers?

SNT-TC-1A is the standard personnel qualification basis used by US construction, industrial and energy employers, including in Central Texas. The certification is issued by your employer.

Which methods are most in demand on Central Texas construction projects?

UT, MT and VT for structural steel, with PAUT, PT and RT for piping and pressure equipment. Ask the contractor which scopes they are staffing.

Can you train a new crew before a fab or data-centre project starts?

Yes. Corporate programmes combine online theory and onsite practical sessions to prepare a crew ahead of mobilisation.

Do you offer CWI or API courses in Austin?

No. Atlantis NDT trains to ASNT SNT-TC-1A only.

How can I prepare for the practical exam?

Use the Practical NDT simulator to rehearse, then gain hands-on time with real equipment. The exam is on real specimens under a Level III.

Where can I find UT Level 2 practice questions?

See our UT Level 2 practice questions and the mock exams included in each course.

Planning training for your Austin team? Get an Austin training quote, see all NDT training programmes, or explore Level III preparation.
